sources.description: New York Giants head coach John Harbaugh enters a familiar battleground in the NFC East with a history that suggests he could make an immediate impact. During his 18-year run with the Baltimore Ravens, Harbaugh consistently found success against NFC East opponents, posting a 13-8 regular-season record.
